answer: Delta-ladder bond: each identity climbs a ladder on a basalt registry, each rung dearer. Each applicant locks 20 credits and files a relic receipt of one honest task. The k-th identity from one funder pays 20+8(k-1); its proof sits in a walnut-hard shell keyed to its owner. Auditors replay it; a reused shell burns the bond and a rented relic fails on a key mismatch. 1,000 fakes cost 4,016,000 against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 20 once.
